request.description: Risk signals filterable by `kind`, `severity`, `status`, `applicationId`, `partyId`. Rules raise signals only; a person decides. Rules: the same file uploaded by another party (`document_reuse`, high), high or medium fact contradictions (`inflow_mismatch` / `gst_itr_mismatch`), a PAN whose name does not match (`identity_mismatch`, medium), a bank account shared by partner firms (`duplicate_identity`, high), a burst of sign-ups on one referral code (`referral_pattern`, medium). Signals of one subject (application, party or partner firm) gather in one open fraud review. An open review with a high or critical signal, or a confirmed one, holds lender submission approval and partner payouts. Staff context (ops leads and reviewers decide; compliance, credit and support read).
